result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Gusto is the best overall payroll software**, particularly if you want payroll, tax calculations, employee payments and basic HR management in one place.

However, the best choice depends on where your business operates, how many employees you have and whether you want to manage payroll yourself or automate as much as possible.

Here are my top recommendations for 2026.

## Best payroll software compared

![Gusto Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ftD0qJ1yBSoWTtDEs2sOfDQ7-65e7zEzHy-HIAb3bqFrmNGGc0DyUX0E7CdY1ulVg_3Q5_8qLVi4LE1wqaQS_JVEpU9pxbwM6Kz6OYgPCcQM2vYw21WPy-MCNW4IYnmmdNSrLtuLoIyJLYtPy5hO5B7jEV7698TKyyKP6yzFWMR7Sgf2P81H8Y7V-Tx23IPn?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Gusto**

(Best overall)

- Easy to use.
- Automated payroll and tax filing.
- Employee self-service and HR features.
- Good for small and growing teams.

US pricing reported from \$49/month + \$6 per employee.

[Visit Gusto](https://gusto.com/)

**2\. QuickBooks Payroll**

(Best for accounting integration)

- Integrates with QuickBooks accounting.
- Payroll and tax automation.
- Useful financial reporting.
- Good for businesses already using QuickBooks.

US pricing reported from \$50/month + \$7 per employee.

[Visit QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/payroll/)

![](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Lcpph5RlN0vwjThtvq4aAP5_BTIZyfe97vMXmnZoQsy6U7u19TDwLWj4IWN3oY66nYSGy2P_lG5hzETnrs6wypJeJq3Ko-4oqglLGy5SAvWGyFZyyAs3G1ltzrEDZQGqzHqLgAQpy9qzqi3oeuhnGKKzbn74nakWd0CKMPmYLCQown6z8TCv9VTkqJXMjSkk?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. OnPay**

(Best for simplicity)

- Straightforward payroll processing.
- Tax filing included in its full-service offering.
- Supports multi-state payroll.
- Good for smaller businesses.

US pricing reported from \$49/month + \$6 per worker.

[Visit OnPay](https://onpay.com/)

![RUN Powered by ADP® Payroll Software | ADP](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RpGcHs-PaNOo1cKIxFpsEQuw9zfE12TEYccICxkqqcA3CO2NvRfDtJbCfHi2Nr0YYYblVCChq2UL52-TzeRVq7RXCW745y0Vk8MEKZHTp113Xnj3kep_aCHaeYLzdBWH7veM5Y6_lQASKp9n8UaI6GWb3lo9RY4lH6rVom7VA1O8HweTnOpsYnwKG4YX01TL?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. ADP RUN**

(Best for growing businesses)

- Established payroll provider.
- Payroll tax administration.
- HR support and compliance tools.
- Suitable for businesses expecting to expand.

Custom pricing; request a quote.

**5\. Rippling**

- Automated employee onboarding.
- Extensive integrations.
- Useful for more complex growing teams.

Customised pricing.

## My recommendation for a UK small business

If your business is based in the UK, I would shortlist these instead of the US-focused options above.

| Software | Best for |
|--------|--------|
| Sage Payroll | Best all-round standalone payroll |
| BrightPay | Dedicated payroll management |
| Xero Payroll | Businesses already using Xero |
| Moneysoft | Low-cost payroll |
| Employment Hero | Payroll combined with HR |


Sources: [www.workforce.com](https://www.workforce.com/uk/buyers-guides/best-payroll-software-in-the-uk-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[smallbusiness.co.uk](https://smallbusiness.co.uk/compare-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses-2603489/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[whichpayroll.com](https://whichpayroll.com/uk/best-payroll-software-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[paydocs.co](https://paydocs.co/blog/uk-payroll-providers-compared?utm_source=chatgpt.com)\.

For UK payroll, make sure your software supports\:

- PAYE tax and National Insurance calculations.
- Real Time Information (RTI) submissions to HMRC.
- Workplace pension auto-enrolment.
- Holiday pay and statutory sick pay.
- P45s, P60s and payslips.

search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
